text:
A DVC Friendship Story: 35 Years and Counting | Disney Files On Demand
Meet Disney Vacation Club Cast Members Lorraine and Stephania, whose 35-year friendship began in 1991 when they helped open the very first Disney Vacation Club Resort, now known as Disney’s Old Key West Resort.

From opening day to today, their friendship is a special part of their Disney Vacation Club story. Hear Lorraine and Stephania reflect on the memories, milestones and magic they’ve shared along the way.
